I have worked this small plot behind my house since I was a boy, and my father taught me to put cow dung on it before planting when the rains come. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for only this small piece because one bag costs too much and is more than the plot needs, so I will use only the manure I have saved. I will plant the maize seed I kept from last season, and my family will pull the weeds by hand without any spray. We will spend about fifteen days on this plot from planting to harvest, and I will not pay for hired labor because we can manage the work ourselves.
